settings.title: Settings
settings.pwaInstallHint: Open the browser menu and choose “Install” or “Add to Home screen”. If the option is missing, the app is already installed.
settings.lockScreenHint: To control music from the lock screen, open .sound in a browser

pwa.safari: In Safari, tap Share, then “Add to Home screen”.
pwa.ios: Tap Share (⋯) in the toolbar, then “Add to Home screen”.
pwa.other: Use the browser menu: “Install” or “Add to Home (screen)”.
pwa.valueProp: Open the player from the home screen in one tap.
pwa.onbSubtitle: Works like a native app — no browser bar, no address line.
pwa.onbMenuHint: Open the browser menu and choose “Install app”
pwa.iosSafariStep1Desc: The arrow-up button in the center of the Safari bottom bar.
pwa.iosSafariStep2Desc: Scroll the action list and find this option.
pwa.iosSafariStep3Desc: Confirm in the dialog. The .sound icon will appear on your home screen.
pwa.iosOtherStep1Desc: Tap the Share or ••• button in your browser toolbar.
pwa.iosOtherStep2Desc: Tap this option in the action list.
pwa.androidBipStep1Desc: The browser will add .sound to your home screen as a full app.
pwa.androidOtherStep2Desc: Or “Add to Home Screen” — depends on your browser.
